confidence.rationale: Deterministic extraction from repository policy files.

procedure: 1. Collect facts with the Google Form built from `docs/client-onboarding-intake.md`; columns must match `templates/onboarding/intake-template.csv`.
2. Export the reviewed Sheet row to CSV (keep exports out of git; `*.csv` is ignored except the template).
4. The script writes `src/clients/<id>/{client.config.ts,content.en.ts,content.el.ts}`, registers the client in `src/lib/config/registry.ts`, and runs `validate:config`.
5. Review generated Greek and policy copy (`compliance.legalReviewed` stays false), confirm production contact facts, and set `compliance.legalReviewed: true` only after actual client/legal review.
6. Run `$env:ACTIVE_CLIENT="<id>"; npm run validate:production` before public launch; fix every issue it reports.
7. Run `npm run verify` and, for launch, `npm run test:e2e`.
8. Deploy a Vercel project with `ACTIVE_CLIENT=<id>` and a domain matching `site.productionUrl`.
- 2026-06-19: Added production launch gate, stricter Google schedule placeholder validation, and Playwright smoke tests to the onboarding workflow.
- 2026-06-20: Generated policy copy no longer uses "sample" wording, but `compliance.legalReviewed` still stays false until real review.
rollback: Keep the record as candidate or delete it before promotion.
